feeds.title: D&G Design
feeds.description: Combining over 20 years of experience in heritage restoration and interior design, with a devoted love of Italy, David and Gary decided to promote properties to overseas buyers and offer their skills and expertise. They work closely with a team of skilled, reliable, and trustworthy professionals including structural engineers, architects, geometra, builders, notaries, and lawyers. Gain practical advice if you're house-hunting or renovating in Italy, enjoy the summer life, go for kitchen, bathroom make-overs, renovate rooftops, and more.

feeds.title: Puk Blog
feeds.description: Puk specializes in the study and creation of lighting solutions for architectural and outdoor applications. They are as ambitious and determined as you are and they can work with you to create something spectacular and unique. The blog leads you on the path to the world of design lighting, architectural lighting, and Italian designs, be it your home or workplace, you will find something useful here.

feeds.title: Cipì
feeds.description: Cipì Ltd. was founded in 2003 and since then produces, designed, and distributes bathroom accessories and household. The main target market remains the Bathroom. Accessories countertops, sinks, furniture, and mirrors are the product categories most representative of their catalog. Wood, stone, resin, and metal are the materials employed for the realization of the products that best represent the style Cipì. Check out the blog for bathroom designs, furniture, washbasin, and accessories for the bathroom.

feeds.title: Interni Magazine » Design
feeds.description: Founded in 1954, Interni Magazine covers interiors and contemporary design. From building cities to buildings, from home decor to workplace renovation, hotels to rooms the magazine covers design. It also contains interviews, opinions, insights, investigations, and more for design lovers. Browse through the website to seek design ideas for various sectors such as technology, architecture, mobility, schools, communication, and more.

feeds.title: Design Diffusion
feeds.description: Design Diffusion is a journalistic site that disseminates information and culture of the project and design in Italy and throughout the world. Its goal is to timely deliver engaging content for your B2B marketing! It is continuously updating the specialized public, as well as the simply passionate one, on its central themes of product innovations and latest trends, interior design and major architectural projects, technological innovation, fairs and exhibitions, leading figures in the world of design and businesses, institutional and corporate affairs.

feeds.title: Villegiardini » Design
feeds.description: Founded in 1956, Villegiardini possesses the prestige of an internationally recognized paper historian. It publishes design, furniture, architecture, art, gardens, plants, culture, lifestyle, and the most interesting news. The Magazine provides readers with design articles, editorials, decor, design icons, information, and updates.

feeds.title: Picame
feeds.description: Picame is a web magazine dedicated to the visual arts that celebrates and inspires creatives from all over the world. Their work is based on continuous research and interception of avant-garde and new trends, supported by an attentive and receptive community that has over half a million users including professionals, companies, students, and simple enthusiasts. Take a look at these illustrations and read more about their history.

feeds.title: Design Italy Blog
feeds.description: Design Italy's people passionately share the goal of promoting Italian design in the world. Roberto founded Design Italy with his wife, Paola, following decades as an executive, advisor, and investor in key multinational and Italian companies in the world of digital business and innovation. Each blog showcases a specific category of iconic pieces of design. Here you can find ideas on furniture, home decor, lighting, outdoors, art, and more.

feeds.title: Milan Design Agenda
feeds.description: Milan Design Agenda writes about the world's luxury brands, exclusive design trends, lifestyle, and, above all, an educational luxury culture. The articles published are more than an insight into exclusive luxury categories. Its goal is to provide you with the best information about furniture pieces, architecture, interior design projects, design boutiques, and Milan fashion events. Tour the blog for the latest news, articles, and information about designs.

feeds.title: Coffee Break Blog
feeds.description: Coffee Break is a blog by Cafelab. Cafelab is an architecture firm based in Rome. Since 2008 they have been creating unique and memorable environments by focusing their architectural research on the quality of the designed spaces; they love to use natural and sustainable materials such as iron, steel,, stone, marble and wood and carefully integrate them with lighting. Here you will find inspirational homes, design products, new trends from the world of interior design and achievements from their architecture studio.
